description: The lights of the hospital room of Harry's dream with Lisa (map4_s04, cell HU0103) for the setting extra_lights. The room has no fixture of its own, but the original lights the 'Where am I?' scene from a lamp's place: it detaches the light from Harry and hangs it at the ceiling over the bed, (57.0, -3.0, 141.8), pointing straight down (Cutscene_WhereAmI), and the talk with Lisa that follows keeps a scene light. The lamp here hangs at that point and stays on until the talk is over (M4S04_LisaTalkCutsceneDone); afterwards the original returns to the flashlight and so does the room. Positions are metres, PS1 axes (y down).

lights.name: CeilingLamp
lights.description: The lamp over the bed: weak and warm, so the walls and Lisa get a soft light around the scene's own beam.
